description: This Java source file defines an immutable class 'ImmutableTopicPathPlaceholder' which implements the 'TopicPathPlaceholder' interface. The class provides functionality to handle different placeholders related to topic paths, such as 'full', 'namespace', 'entityName', etc., and methods to resolve these placeholders from a 'TopicPath' object. It is part of a package likely used for handling message topics in a messaging system within the 'org.eclipse.ditto' project.

classes.name: ImmutableTopicPathPlaceholder
classes.description: A singleton immutable class that provides placeholder support for topic paths, allowing resolution of specific fields such as namespace, entity name, group, etc., from a TopicPath object.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix 'topic' which identifies the placeholder type.

methods.name: getSupportedNames
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable list of supported placeholder names.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if the given placeholder name is supported.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the value of the specified placeholder from the given TopicPath object, returning an Optional containing the string value.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the class.
